title: Restore active message group and caller-gated room member controls

source.ref: Actual Frequency inbox and RLS-gated room roster wiring

detail: Restore the group-message compose door and room invite/member-management UI using the existing caller-gated public roster, never a new privileged read. Read-denied and Channel rooms show no roster controls; private invite/admin/self affordances mirror existing server checks. Member controls are visible and keyboard reachable, focus their actions, close on Escape, disable duplicate pending mutations and expose inline errors. Server member mutations propagate read/write errors without false success revalidation. The crew-lead shortcut is restored only on inbox using its existing trusted profile read and RLS client; accepted friends only, excluding self/host, and no extra reads for nonleads. Existing server group-DM friend constraints remain. BoardControls was reviewed: active Frequency Crew/Circle boards already retain scope/track/opt-out replacements, so no feature was blindly deleted. Atomic room mutations remain default-off under HYG205 and production flag activation remains root-controlled. Three exact RPC types were extracted from the genuine post-migration live generator artifact; unrelated catalog drift was not applied. Actions call the generated typed client without handwritten RPC casts or schema allowances. Optional descriptions normalize to an empty string, which the registered SQL NULLIF converts to the same absent-description value. Rendered/mocked/source proof only; authenticated browser and production acceptance remain separate. Security follow-up: stored room visibility and scope identity control whether a rename may change visibility; scoped/unknown rooms never receive submitted visibility or scope fields. Manual-room writes compare stored visibility and null scope and require a matched acknowledgement. Actual settings hide scoped visibility controls. File form values are rejected before trimming. Join, invite and deletion propagate returned database/transport failures with generic retry messages and no success revalidation; deletion UI recovers while preserving successful Next redirects. Additive tests cover forged scope payloads, real admin/member/friend boundaries, pending/keyboard behavior and retry paths.
